redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Volleyball Zero Codes
Redeeming codes in Volleyball Zero is simple and doesn’t require any special level or conditions. Just follow these steps:
1. Launch Volleyball Zero on Roblox using [[roblox_link|Launch Volleyball Zero]].
2. Look for the Codes option in the bottom menu of the game screen.
3. Click on Codes and enter a valid code in the text box labeled ‘Enter Code..’
4. Press the Redeem button to claim your rewards instantly.
Make sure you type the codes exactly as they appear to avoid errors.

troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Sometimes codes don’t work because they are expired or typed incorrectly. Double-check spelling and capitalization. Also, make sure the code is still active since Volleyball Zero is in playtest and codes can change quickly.
